options.name: Converting Spell Slots to Sorcery Points

aberrant-sorcery.summary: A Sorcerer touched by alien psionics, with telepathy, mind-bending spells and a body that can mutate at will.

Psionic Spells.summary: Extra always-prepared spells arrive at Sorcerer levels 3, 5, 7 and 9, ranging from Mind Sliver and Detect Thoughts up to Telekinesis and Telepathic Bond.

Telepathic Speech.summary: Bonus Action: link minds with a creature you see within 30 ft for minutes equal to your Sorcerer level, talking telepathically within CHA miles (min 1) in a shared language. A new link ends the old one.

Psionic Sorcery.summary: Cast your level 1+ Psionic Spells with Sorcery Points equal to the spell's level instead of a slot; cast that way they need no Verbal, Somatic or Material components unless the material is consumed or has a cost.

Psychic Defenses.summary: Resistance to Psychic damage; Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed and Frightened.

Revelation in Flesh.summary: Bonus Action: spend 1+ Sorcery Points to transform for 10 minutes, picking one benefit below per point spent.

options.name: Aquatic Adaptation
options.summary: Swim Speed of twice your Speed, and you breathe underwater.

options.name: Glistening Flight
options.summary: Gain a Fly Speed matching your Speed; hovering allowed.

options.name: See the Invisible
options.summary: You see Invisible creatures within 60 ft that lack Total Cover.

options.name: Wormlike Movement
options.summary: Squeeze through 1-inch gaps; spend 5 ft of movement to slip nonmagical restraints or a grapple.

Warping Implosion.summary: Magic action: teleport up to 120 ft to a space you see. Creatures within 30 ft of where you stood make a STR save vs your spell DC: 3d10 Force and pulled toward that spot on a fail, half damage only on a success. 1/Long Rest, or 5 Sorcery Points to reuse.

clockwork-sorcery.summary: A Sorcerer channeling cosmic order to cancel luck, ward allies and impose calm precision.

Clockwork Spells.summary: Extra always-prepared spells arrive at Sorcerer levels 3, 5, 7 and 9, from Aid and Alarm up to Greater Restoration and Wall of Force. Your casting shows a cosmetic sign of order.

Restore Balance.summary: Reaction: a creature you see within 60 ft that would roll a d20 with Advantage or Disadvantage rolls with neither instead. CHA uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

Bastion of Law.summary: Magic action: spend 1–5 Sorcery Points to ward yourself or a creature within 30 ft with that many d8s. When hurt, the warded creature rolls any number of them to cut the damage. Lasts until your Long Rest or a new ward.

Trance of Order.summary: Bonus Action: for 1 minute, attacks against you can't have Advantage, and your D20 Test rolls of 9 or lower count as 10. 1/Long Rest, or 5 Sorcery Points to reuse.

Clockwork Cavalcade.summary: Magic action: spirits of order fill a 30-ft Cube from you, healing up to 100 HP split as you like, mending objects inside, and ending spells of level 6 or lower on chosen targets. 1/Long Rest, or 7 Sorcery Points to reuse.

wild-magic-sorcery.summary: A Sorcerer whose chaotic inner magic can erupt in random surges and bend luck.

Wild Magic Surge.summary: Once per turn after casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot, you may roll a d20; a 20 means a roll on the surge table. A spell a surge creates can't take Metamagic.

Tides of Chaos.summary: Before a D20 Test, grant yourself Advantage on it. It comes back on a Long Rest or when you next cast a Sorcerer spell with a slot, which also triggers a surge roll.

uses.restore: casting a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot (also rolls a surge)

Bend Luck.summary: Reaction right after another creature you see rolls a D20 Test: spend 1 Sorcery Point and roll 1d4 to add to or subtract from its roll.

Controlled Chaos.summary: Surge table rolls are made twice; you pick which result applies.

Tamed Surge.summary: Right after casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot, choose any surge table effect except the last row instead of rolling (roll any dice it calls for). 1/Long Rest.
